name: Maximum Classes Are Ample
proof: Let $H\subseteq2^X$ have VC dimension $d$. If $H$ is maximum, then $|H|=\sum_{i=0}^{d}\binom{|X|}{i}$. Every shattered set has size at most $d$, so $|\operatorname{str}(H)|\leq\sum_{i=0}^{d}\binom{|X|}{i}$. The sandwich inequality $|H|\leq|\operatorname{str}(H)|$ therefore holds with equality, which is equivalent to ampleness.
comments: The survey also states that the reverse inclusion fails; strictness will be promoted when a witness record is migrated.
